messages:
alex: pushed a tiny docs PR to tidy the streaming example and add an explicit retry/backoff note for paginated endpoints — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/789
maria: taking a look now. are we keeping Python + TS only? or should we add a Go micro-snippet too?
sam: +1 for Go. keep it minimal: iterator + retry backoff example.
jess: heads-up — prod SDK exposes the new stream-iter API. we should show migration from old cursor API briefly.
devx-bot: PR lint passed. preview build: https://deploy.preview.redwood.ai/preview/789 — status: ✅
alex: sweet. ok let's add Go. maria can you draft the Go snippet? i'll add a small blurb about retry semantics and a note about tokenization/cost.
maria: drafting now. quick q: for retries do we want exponential backoff with full jitter in the snippet?
sam: yes. show a simple expo with cap + full jitter. pseudo-code is fine.
jess: also call out batching caveat — batching changes latency/cost tradeoffs; link to Optimize guide.
alex: i'll add cross-links. also we need this backported to the v1.2 branch after merge — who can open the backport PR?
maria: i can open the backport once merged.
alex: timeline — try to get this in tomorrow's docs release notes.
maria: aiming for EOD today, ping me if blocked.
sam: one more for the TS snippet: show stream error handling via AbortController example.
jess: and add a tiny test-snippet that asserts pagination stops when next_token is null.
alex: adding TODOs in the PR comment.
devx-bot: @alex requested reviewers: @maria @sam @jess
maria: review done; left one nit about wording around "retry on 429 vs 503". LGTM after that.
sam: addressed my comments in the PR.
jess: added migration note and a short diff showing the new iter usage. LGTM.
alex: merged. thanks all. @maria please open the backport when ready.
maria: backport opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/790
alex: deployed to staging docs site. preview: https://docs.redwood.ai/staging/streams#retries
sam: spotted a broken anchor in the TS snippet linking to Optimize — should be #batching not #batching-guide.
maria: fixing the anchor now.
alex: all set. i'll include a short blurb in release notes about "streaming resiliency examples".

maria: small TS error handling snippet I added for reviewers:
```ts
const controller = new AbortController();
const res = await client.stream({ model: 'redwood-chat-1', input }, { signal: controller.signal });
try {
  for await (const chunk of res) {
    // handle chunk
  }
} catch (err) {
  // retry-or-log
}
```

sam: and the Go retry pseudo:
```go
backoff := func(attempt int) time.Duration { return time.Duration(math.Pow(2, float64(attempt))) * time.Millisecond }
// full jitter sample omitted for brevity
```

jess: note in docs: "Retries should target idempotent streaming endpoints only; non-idempotent mutations need application-level dedupe." :thumbsup:

alex: perfect. merging helped tighten the examples. thanks everyone! :)
